rapport_notes: Warm, thanked the repeat customer by history; patient through the customer's own audio interruptions.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'in case you just end up less than the estimated time that would be okay, you only need to pay once the job is done and only for the actual hours' (beats-it/window)

top_strength: Recognized and thanked a repeat customer by name/history early in the call, building immediate rapport.
coaching_note: The close attempt got cut off mid-sentence when the customer asked her to repeat ('Would you like me?...') and was never re-asked cleanly — worth circling back to a direct close question after clarifying, rather than moving straight to logistics.
